title: Translation requests
bodyMd:
A service counts requests received and requests completed within five working days. Each completed request belongs to the received cohort shown.

| Category | Received | Completed within five days |
|---|---:|---:|
| Office North | 40 | 30 |
| Office Central | 80 | 52 |
| Office South | 120 | 108 |
